title: ConVIRT
paper_title: Contrastive Learning of Medical Visual Representations from Paired Images and Text
core_mech: 将自然生成的医学图像–报告对输入全局双塔，通过双向跨模态对比预训练医学视觉 encoder。
core_mech_en: Pretrains medical visual encoders directly from naturally occurring paired radiology images and free-text reports via bidirectional contrastive loss.
input_desc: 医学图像与配套自由文本报告
input_en: Paired medical image (e.g., chest X-ray) and corresponding clinical radiology report sentence
output_desc: 对齐的图像与报告全局表征
output_en: Contrastively aligned visual encoder representation for downstream low-label classification

source.title: ConVIRT
notes: The author-linked repository contains CheXpert image/text retrieval evaluation CSVs, not ConVIRT model or training code. Treat the paper as the model implementation source. Independent community implementations exist but are not author code.

gaps: The identified author release contains evaluation material, not a complete verified ConVIRT training implementation. The image/text encoders, pair sampling and full pretraining recipe still need a paper-based implementation.
